# Check golden provenance

These byte-exact JSON envelopes are generated by the Rust `ooxml` binary from
the committed fixtures named in `tests/check.rs`:

```sh
UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 cargo test --test check six_recipe_and_bad_fixture_reports_match_deterministic_goldens
```

Every case passes `--openxml-sdk skip` so the contract does not depend on the
runner's installed SDK. Inputs are repository-relative paths, findings are
sorted and deduplicated before serialization, and `.gitattributes` pins this
directory to LF on every platform. Review every changed field and finding code
before committing an update.
